description: This Java class caches the current list of allowed locales based on global property updates within the OpenMRS platform, implementing the GlobalPropertyListener to respond to property changes.

classes.name: GlobalLocaleList
classes.description: A utility class which caches the current list of allowed locales, rebuilding the list whenever the global properties are updated. Implements GlobalPropertyListener to update its cache based on property changes.

methods.name: globalPropertyChanged
methods.description: Updates the set of allowed locales when the corresponding global property changes.

methods.name: globalPropertyDeleted
methods.description: Resets the allowed locales cache when the relevant global property is deleted.

methods.name: supportsPropertyName
methods.description: Checks if the given property name is the allowed locales list property supported by this listener.

methods.name: getAllowedLocales
methods.description: Returns the current cached set of allowed locales.
